mapper.select: SELECT so.id AS id, so.order_no AS orderNo, so.sale_time AS saleTime, so.item_count AS itemCount, so.payable_amount AS payableAmount, so.paid_amount AS paidAmount, so.change_amount AS changeAmount, so.return_status AS returnStatus, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ro.refund_amount) FROM return_order ro WHERE ro.sales_order_id = so.id), 0) AS refundAmount FROM sales_order so WHERE so.shift_id = #{shiftId} ORDER BY so.sale_time ASC, so.id ASC
